    int
    BudgetCourseService.refreshCache(String quarter, Collection<RecruitmentCourse> rows, Map<String, UcsbSection> sections)
    After a fetch of the whole quarter's offerings (Populate, or the Courses page's refresh): makes sure every given recruitment course has its row, re-caches the figures of every row of the quarter whose section the fetch found, and stamps every row of the quarter as checked now, found or not, so a section the API has dropped does not keep the quarter stale for ever.
